column1: # Custom DCGM counter set for dcgm-exporter.
# Rendered into the ConfigMap "dcgm-custom-metrics" (see kustomization.yaml) and
# referenced by the GPU Operator via dcgmExporter.config.name.
# The PROF_* fields are the profiling counters that carry the REAL utilization
# signal. GPU_UTIL alone only means "a kernel was running" - the whole point of
# this project is to show the gap between that and actual SM/tensor activity.

column3: GPU utilization (time a kernel was active - NOT saturation).
Fraction of time at least one warp was active on an SM.
Fraction of resident warps on an SM.
Fraction of time the tensor (HMMA) pipe was active.
Fraction of time the device memory interface was active.
